scenario: A medical billing specialist processes a patient encounter note through an entity extraction step, then runs it through a coding assistant to assign ICD-10 diagnosis codes and CPT procedure codes, and finally generates a CMS claim summary report for submission.
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor parses the raw clinical note into structured entities (symptoms, diagnoses, medications) → icd10-cpt-coding-assistant maps those entities to ICD-10 and CPT codes, scoring E/M complexity to select the billable visit level → reporting compiles the codes and visit level into a CMS claim summary.
